facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says Rwanda implemented its personal data protection law in October 2021.
facts.system: Law Relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says Rwanda ratified the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection in November 2019.
Digital Policy Alert says the National Cyber Security Authority oversees data governance and established its Data Protection Office in 2022.
Digital Policy Alert says the Data Protection Office issued guidance on registration of controllers and processors in June 2023 and further guidance through July 2024.
